These states are the first to act, but not the last. Not when the Supreme Court has rolled back decades of progress and made racial gerrymandering a thing again.
RUSH $35 or more right now to fight back against voter suppression and defend our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070726_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Supreme Court voted to gut the Voting Rights Act. Now, anti-voting politicians in states throughout the country have a clear path to implement devastating voter suppression schemes, Team.
Opponents of voting rights are already taking new voter suppression actions in Tennessee, Louisiana, and South Carolina , where maps are being hastily redrawn as we speak to gerrymander voting districts, and ballots that were already cast have been thrown out in states like Alabama.
Our tools and programs:
➜ Help voters get re-registered in their new districts.
➜ Find their new polling locations.
➜ Speak up for their right to cast a ballot.
The need for this work is greater than ever before. This is an "all hands on deck" moment , and we are fighting on the front lines to defend the right to vote for every American.

It’s no secret, Peter.

I’ve been on a winning streak throughout my career in public service. 6-0 in statewide races.
I’ve won six tough races here in North Carolina – and whether I was fighting to expand Medicaid, add jobs or increase teacher pay, I put North Carolinians first, no matter what. It has been the opportunity of a lifetime to serve the people and place I love so much.
**You have to know this, though: Having won in the past won’t be enough to win this time around.

** This Senate race is bigger. The stakes are higher. The attacks on and distortions of my record are more outlandish and harmful. The money is pouring in at a rapid pace.
Republican dark-money super PACs are investing nearly $100 million so far to defeat me and keep this seat red – and **it was just reported that my Trump-backed opponent and his allies are outspending us nearly 5:1.**
Peter, I need your help. We’ve been able to stay competitive in this race, but only because of grassroots support from people like you. We have to keep fighting – and we cannot let this Washington DC insider and his MAGA allies buy this seat.
[**_Can I count on you to chip in $5 or whatever you can today to ensure we have the resources to flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk778_1&amount=5&t=8&akid=2017%2E124072%2EPWu-aV)

Thank you,

Roy Cooper

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

body:
What I saw at the grocery store this week. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134833213/632345707/-903484763?&refcode=E30738-20260708-GroceryStore-Image-Economy&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGM5NjZhODItNmE3YS1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=eB2QuMT0tWRjADIdCDr9TkfzP3VNRkxJecD8U0tJrcc=) Peter, The other day, Pam sent me to the grocery store to grab burgers, hot dogs, and everything we needed for the Fourth of July. _**I couldn't believe the total.**_ More than $5 for ketchup. | | **OPEC Raised Quotas. Hormuz Shipping Is Recovering. The 5-Year Breakeven Rate Hit 2.2%. Three Simultaneous Signals Say July 15 CPI Has a Clear Path Below 3.5%.**
---
| | Three oil and inflation signals arrived this weekend in combination: OPEC and its allies agreed to raise crude production quotas, adding supply pressure to a market already near $68 WTI. Bloomberg reported signs of recovery in Strait of Hormuz shipping, meaning the post-war normalization of tanker traffic is proceeding. And the five-year breakeven inflation rate — the bond market’s real-time measure of expected average inflation over five years — fell to **2.2%** , its lowest level since October 2024, down from 2.7% in mid-May. The Deloitte global economic update attributed the rapid decline to two events: the assumed end of the Iran conflict and Warsh’s public statements on inflation focus. The bond market, in other words, already believes the Fed is winning on inflation. **At 2.2% breakeven, the bond market is pricing a world where July 15 CPI is the beginning of the end of the inflation problem, not a one-off reading.**
---
| | The three signals are mutually reinforcing, and each independently points toward a sub-3.5% June CPI print. ISM Manufacturing prices paid fell from 82.1 to 73.0 in June — the largest single-month decline since 2022, reflecting Brent’s fall from $88 to $74 flowing through manufacturing input costs with its standard 4–6 week lag. OPEC’s production increase means Brent will stay near $68 or lower through July, extending that pipeline into August. Hormuz shipping normalization removes the secondary supply chain cost that had persisted even after crude prices fell. **The remaining risk is Iran succession** — the Assembly of Experts deadline is today, and a destabilizing succession outcome would reverse all three signals. Watch Brent. If it stays below $74 through the succession announcement, the CPI disinflation path is confirmed. If it moves above $76, the three signals are at risk simultaneously.
---

| | **FOMC Minutes Release Wednesday at 2 PM. Without Forward Guidance, This Is Now the Most Important Fed Communication of the Quarter. Three Questions It Must Answer.**
---
| | The FOMC minutes from the June meeting release Wednesday July 8 at 2 PM ET. Under Warsh’s explicitly post-forward-guidance framework — where the dot plot no longer functions as a commitment and pre-meeting signals have been retired — the minutes serve a different function than before. They are now the market’s only structured inside view of what the committee actually thinks. Three questions the minutes must answer: **How close was the vote?** A unanimous hold is very different from a contested 7–5. **How many members wanted to hike in June?** If four or more dissented toward hiking, October becomes near-certain regardless of the +57K payrolls. **How did the committee describe the inflation trajectory?** PCE at 4.1% as a floor means October is locked. PCE as a temporary peak means October is flexible. The answer to those three questions will reprice October hike odds immediately on Wednesday afternoon.
---
| | Wednesday is also approximately the Iran succession deadline — the Assembly of Experts’ five-day constitutional window expires today or tomorrow. **FOMC minutes at 2 PM and Iran succession announcement on the same day creates the highest-volatility session of the week.** The 10-year Treasury yield will move on both simultaneously: dovish minutes push yields lower, hawkish minutes push them higher, while Brent moving above $76 on succession uncertainty adds inflation expectations upward pressure. If the two events move in opposite directions — hawkish minutes pushing yields up while a constructive succession pushes oil down — they partially offset. If they move in the same direction, the session could produce 10+ basis point moves in the 10-year. For the bond investor: hold short duration through Wednesday. For the equity investor: Wednesday is the week’s highest-information session. Do not act before 3 PM when the full picture becomes clear.
---

## States Seek $1.4 Trillion from Meta
Four states are seeking a whopping [$1.4 trillion in penalties](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ8GOiP_AKZxkYbupk2JFryGTYx9ZO-5hLePSJQnuO3o06eZ-fGxfABFSvt3ONFxyEvCq0ZkxrKcyFDf6EMuqudCMVJOF8Rz0VKPQlohp8UDxXvpW-8CokbTolN2MoMcRjO0h1u33oceV2vtaL3xBtVogwE1GKuDCS25xyatnJRUZjDdqsDjNmg5aUCQa9NL9MS5dD8zJT4wxDt_Yum2fLbRHcyv2phvjZ4bPV_X1YX8e31XSljrwzR6ZtyOlGPe70bPIb-LqAyMVVTEX5R2oUQv_i8UL0wQmbCK7aDoRc0bQRQnegIB3tPGD8blX8ogKty1Lc6_rkdRR9v0cj-B4t-O_KVjP53-EwAA__-axZEM) from Meta, claiming Facebook and Instagram were designed to addict children and that the company misled the public about the platforms' safety. The sum approaches Meta's [entire market capitalization](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUD2PpDAU-zXQgZJHSLgixTV0c-2V6EEeQ27yMUreDZp_v2JX-wu2s2zLsv33ttzQB5_ufzCS5T0vic4aiJnKEomx_ie35yIVFx-Cz-nEEBcQoDthOjEtDn14L6p1dicCGlqy0kzDKEY9jO1hFQiHk1FITq1unwy4VUqnf0llVmnW1tsrTRgxSSGHcehXiY62EcQESCjWRglynnPp_2Wf-KA9vPOLSr_l2AZ7MD9rM_xuYG5g3n3CtFH_xiPny9HAHLE8iGsDc-W8PS6Ahf0W6ItDptqdmLiTneq-h3YSlBGgte4PjqEt1j3PS6raNErcI_rwWYF_9NvLwkcAAAD__wNYgaQ) of roughly $1.5 trillion. California, Colorado, Kentucky, and New Jersey calculated the figure by multiplying estimated young users harmed by fine amounts set under state law. Meta called the amount unsupported by the facts and far in excess of any previous consumer-protection fine. The trial is set for next month in Oakland, California.
## Walmart Slashes Summer Prices
Walmart announced it was [cutting prices on thousands of groceries](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOpDAQBNCvgczI2HjgAgeXTDaXXojadjN4ZWPW3Qw7f79if2HjKpVK7_9jfkBMcXv-g4yWlzJveFJCZqxzRgY6MCyl9gPXmFIs2wkpz0qqm5CjkNMcIKb3PLTBLogKdYu2HydtpLlp067Wg1sADLpej8Ybr72cFue81uqPG4e-jfZak6OcetlrozvXQ0BvlJwUIEjXDBJD5FK7jxI3XnFJ7_LC2vmS22RX5p0a_bdR90bdz_PslvLlDoobEl2dRt0rMsR0xZAyVBYEmYRPhxOUgFax1-iRBK_lINgCib2WcHgmwfXIuyB4k8jlhcJDRrFGEhU_DyRuqw37ednQbWwG-cwQ0881_pXny6rvAAAA__9wP47r) and household items at both Walmart and Sam's Club, with discounts on beef, soda, produce, and seasonal goods to help consumers struggling with high prices. President Trump praised Walmart for the move, saying the cuts came at his administration's request. Walmart declined to comment on Mr. Trump's post. Among the steepest drops: [24-packs of Coca-Cola fell 33%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ8GOiP_Ailc3CZdbrslGuxx4l2DkT0JytuvnFfYbqRPc46-83VbbhBT3O__YUNLIS87njUhEZZlQ4L6RB9yEZpKTCnm_YS0LZLLkfGJ8XnxENN70b23AVGi6tGKaVaGm1GZ_mGNgnHGMOtw0UKJ0auLHgU3TgUEhaaPtqXxic-CC2XUsArw6IzkswQEvnaao4-Uy_Cd404PDOmdX1gGl7c-2QfRUTv1r5PXTl7P8xzcWptF4528trMBSBsUYkeJDpl7UmUrYmAu_yA78KiRuVx29qEFob32xfrjbN51nDrN7xvE9KmlP231svI3AAD__yTrfoA) to $9.97, ground beef dropped 12%, and fresh corn plunged 63% to $0.25 an ear. The cuts come as inflation has hit its highest level in more than three years.
## List: Which States Tip the Most
America's average restaurant tip has [slipped to 18.8 percent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL8GOiNjsDGFizTXXdqUaMHLsZGxkb136P4-IvmE1PM0o3lf9-kOFCg-PmFHx2uaIp4lIDPmaUeG8kS_ptz2nCkESvGEsE9KKiPkIKSdPFB4T33t3YqosKvRtYPttNSm0_XmFgXWaxjHftSzGUG2q7FmtvOA1vTzWJO72uQgbSvbTnfN3ILHRStpFSDIueoleuKUm-9EkTdcwzu9MDdL2uvgNuajVN1HpW6Vup3n2byoPCEscBBDoMIXeEUbZhSwY6YFYhGFKQTBdAglBUQv_gDe8C18ilypW52dP87reDFD1cvHDhR-d_lfsl5O_QQAAP__O0x_jg), an indication that the long-standing 20% benchmark is no longer the norm, according to a 2026 state-by-state report. At the state level, Delaware customers tipped the most, at an average of 22.1%, and California the least at 17.3%. Overall, full-service restaurants receive much larger gratuities than quick-service restaurants, averaging 19.3% versus 15.8%. The growing use of digital payment screens has expanded tipping requests well beyond traditional restaurants, prompting debate over when gratuities are appropriate. You can see [where your state ranks here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL8GOiNjsDGFizTXXdqUaMHLsZGxkb136P4-IvmE1PM0o3lf9-kOFCg-PmFHx2uaIp4lIDPmaUeG8kS_ptz2nCkESvGEsE9KKiPkIKSdPFB4T33t3YqosKvRtYPttNSm0_XmFgXWaxjHftSzGUG2q7FmtvOA1vTzWJO72uQgbSvbTnfN3ILHRStpFSDIueoleuKUm-9EkTdcwzu9MDdL2uvgNuajVN1HpW6Vup3n2byoPCEscBBDoMIXeEUbZhSwY6YFYhGFKQTBdAglBUQv_gDe8C18ilypW52dP87reDFD1cvHDhR-d_lfsl5O_QQAAP__O0x_jg).

## Toyota Moves Tacoma Production to Texas
Toyota is bringing the Tacoma back to Texas. The automaker [announced Monday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLESmzAMhp_GbOZkQ7AZPHRhS9eOnMBKcGtsDishefse9BG66HT6T_r1f7_u4x1DDOn5E1dy_HnkMdFRIjHTPnL-ZsY1v0N6Ms55Rc5MHyyjBt1JMBLs6DHE79hW3k3ge1WRU8Y2N7AdQLU4NF4bO88tmq5toJ-stR6NuvlWK5qgCu48BgasUtCovlZdN5ke2tkqQH0j0QL5wHmveaHL_hG_-U17Pee1im5h3opofgg9CD0cx1H_KcinKPRwphF6iHnGKPRwWgk9gDlLdw0AZKJD_s5TkesrcpBTiDHkJOmzYSpnt0VMibx85F2W_OJFluBJ_uNzqSz0UO3Ob8e5XDojWniuGOL1JP8f2rfTfwMAAP__ft6NXA) a $3.6 billion expansion of its San Antonio plant, adding a second assembly line and roughly 2,000 jobs by 2030 as it shifts most Tacoma pickup production from its [Tijuana, Mexico, facility](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAMhp8mbEFOoIEOGW5h6603opCYNrokRuCW9u1PtI9wmyXLn__v_7mMFxdTLNdvl9Hyc6ax4L4lZMZ1ZHoRu0yPWK7sPGXHxPh026hBGwmdhH4MLqbX2FbBThDOqkKrur45QW8AqpttGj8FP83OnwBRB9OrOXg1-8mEWfVYRXvAoINeKWjUuVbGTN0ZWt8rcPqEogUMkWmt-Ybv93N60QPX2lOukr0xL5tovoQehB72fa_9tB0Wx17o4RiFHj4yspFGTjGlSEW-YXJJrrDcXJGuMJVI8uMql-h_74tcVgp3z8fBvFKWGZ_Rk9BDtdqw7AdrM51o4ZpdTO9Q_L8qH1b_BQAA__8eqozp) to the Alamo City over the next four years. The project adds 2.5 million square feet, doubling the South Side campus, already home to the Tundra and Sequoia, and bringing [Toyota's total investment](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ8GOq_GBmwoXKShu2lTogEPixX_IDwX2LePdu8jpB2Nzvm-8-dr-kIffHr-xkiW7zVPia4SiJmOifMrM8Z8-vRkXHJEzkw3lkmB0gKMgH5y6MNramtnZ3CDrMlK0zcd9Bqg3mzfOeqMI1qlmWekGUEjrf2gFZhFYe3tOwwM9FJCI4eH1Ho2A7RLLwFVR1UL5Dzn48EbferX8MonHY8lxzrYjXkvVfOrUmOlxuu6Hmu-5-_iE5Xy_qnUGPH4S1wqNf44CZ9OKiwaoWexB0ws6N4xFZ-TKJtfWfwIi_3I7nvh9309chSRbr9k8eGoD-v2y4fgizZVC8-IPnyo-P-2PK36FwAA__-xYY3W) there to $8.3 billion since 2003. Gov. Greg Abbott, touting support from the Texas Enterprise Fund and JETI program, called it a "Texas-sized investment" that cements Texas as "the premier destination for world-class advanced manufacturing." President Trump, whose tariffs have pressured automakers to build stateside, [celebrated on Truth Social](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OwyAUBODTQOfogc2PC4pt3GXbLS1iHjESmMi8_N1-Fe8Rth7pG838nOezTzlt129f0NEr1nnDZ8tIhPtM9V3Jl_pI25X8UounSvjybZYgdQemAzsHn_J7HnhwFwij4OiEsb0CqwH46owffOzH4EMEVAuOMaglRumVkVor4Ml9MDBghYBejCeh9cWMMCxWgJcK2QAYEtX9RCse9TG_6wP301ILz24lujXWfzE5MTnRimvK-ZMxOV3uLW3YGpOTGpW2xnaH0P1N62i_l1tX8JWWyuTEdxduz5RzatqwAa7Fp4Pi9L9zHk7-BgAA___683nz): "_A really big deal. Tariffs at work!_ "
## Marshawn Kneeland Had Stage 1 CTE
Marshawn Kneeland, the Cowboys defensive end who died by suicide in November at 24, had Stage 1 chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), [his family announced Tuesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLtupTAQhp_GdEZjA74ULrahy7ZbosGec7BicAQjCG-_Iq-Q-td_-_59TB-YS97ef3GlwN-vOm10HYWYaZ-43pVxrWfe3oyxrsiV6RuPSYM2EqwENyXM5Z76JoUZklcNBWVdN4AzAM0SINrBvIyDNKQYbfQ2pdkTGYMwEMQmhycMLDiloFO-VcbM1kMfnQLUA4keKGWue8sL_dS_yl1P2ttY16aEhfnrEN0foUehx-u62s9IG5-PLPSIO-dYSOjxeSb0WGrEIvSYsBQ8ZKzXXO9DrrgfC16b_NyICm5JRn5c2lkJXZ-0Slb66LzsIZHEee6lHhQCYkTfUbOH9HXlUvJhrOjhvWIuPxP5d2DPoP8HAAD__6xRjFc). Boston University CTE Center researchers made the diagnosis after Kneeland's brain was donated through the [Concussion & CTE Foundation](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2ypCAQB_DTYMYUoANOQLCJ2dt0Q6uFVqlFegp6x-ftt2au8C7w-3_8-Zq_IOVUtt9woOfvleaCZ8vIjHVmuojhoFcqG0OgA5gYv6HNRhkrlZNqnCOkfM1DF_2i4kN36LUb-7sarVLd7qNdnHVLtKPROkSDzur7qm3f34cY1rVL_o0pp0atVa8fN23t4h5qCKNWYO4oBoUxMdUb7_iJX_NFL6y3QEeX_c78bKL_JcwkzBSohH-tJSpQYmC8Ud2Emd6rhJmeFVuTFTNCQ2GmleqBVUbIGZoMdC50NRlRHlDbDmeRfwtihhJlTLAVahjlmXiXjWFDqWXgt9NVH59nyjk168SgtgNS_vTjn7368uZ_AAAA___TZo-S), which cautioned that a post-mortem CTE diagnosis should not be considered the cause of a suicide. Dr. Ann McKee, the center's director, said she wasn't surprised by the finding, noting researchers have identified the disease in nearly [half of the athletes studied](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE9DdWssaf25UJFG3UubUliRS4sIRRriPvPp9oF8hXQDDDDfzPz5Wr4oxJCev2nnSX58XhLXElmEj0XymYX2_A7pKWTzTpKFf6gsBk0POACOi6MQz6Vt3LSie-iGJz2M9w7HHrHZJjYdP9BgN7Se7YCebNfxOPar0fcOsQnTFYYDjlrjXT9uuu_X4YGtHTWS6Vi1yC5IPm6y8Qfv45nffNxs3ps4bSKvou6_lJmVmWutt7Ra5-tlKzNfe5SZyysfconkozKzz8fOB9hc13zCTkfZqCb4m5gjJQcbOShCTwYNVhjqxgk2BhfYwXpC-Q42OAafv5MjCTmBD8ldgBbbbjSDMnNzTO5VQ4yh9INq8blTiJ_W8n9fvyfzLwAA__-nlJS1) who died before 30. Kneeland, a 2024 second-round pick out of Western Michigan, began playing tackle football at age 7. "_We continue to remember Marshawn with compassion for the person he was_ ," his family said.
## Bexar County Emerges as Rabies Hotspot
Bexar County has emerged as one of the state's most active areas for rabies this year, with a state health department map updated July 6 showing a [cluster of confirmed cases](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOo0AQRL8GsrZ6xhhwQHCJs730QtTDtGG0w7RF99rm70-2_Aeblkqvnurf1_hFKacy_6WVB3teZSz80MxmvI0muxitck9lNppkJRPjJ-no0beAHWA_Rkp5H5s6DgHj2dU8uK4_nrBvEetlaCk6PLngiXDqWk8nT-F69EQRfSBXp-EFww575_DozgfXtqE7YzP1DsmfuGqQYzLZDrbwe_6ad7nzdphkrfOwmN20Ov6p_KXyl5d-o1SomJQkr84nrfwly0S58pfAT9pgkp9iO_DK28wKpPCmw0YhscIipjcxUCNjWOkGushDQanAhw5RZoWJTEG_f8o3BDKttyHeHinnpG1XNTivlPLb1X738H3w_wMAAP__T4CVJw) centered on San Antonio and its surrounding communities. Statewide, bats lead Texas with 90 confirmed rabies cases in 2026, followed closely by skunks at 87 and raccoons at 25, according to the Department of State Health Services [surveillance data](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb8GuqAZY7BduHhNurx2S2vABizZcYRHkPz9KilW2283Rxrdc3W_bu5GMcX7-p9ysPxciruHs6bAHHbH5VWYcjnifWWaSyYuHJ5UnQAxXkBdQDtPMb2cbL2dwBtsg0Wl-wH0CNBuVgsDZgHEySg5TrIHvcgZ9TCoHtGbNtp3GCjQiNCj6XAcJ2VAzhqBxBAaCcFHLnvHW_jol_QqR9i7ueQ22Y35UZv-XyOujbie59n5utXu89mt5WjEdacphvpzXGaqvzHT403vHu1u_eOMKcU6qkbCmimmj4j_Ns9hxXcAAAD__xaNeJA). The virus is turning up well beyond South Texas, too: a skunk in Smith County [tested positive](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdEZj42eTwsU2dNl2S2TwEEYxOMITCH-_Ir_wmttc6Rzp_Lv390CJ1sffsKDnz5T7FY-SkBm3nvOZOSx5p_XBYcxL4Mz4CaXXoK0EJ6HtY6B09qaKfoB4UxV65drmB1oLUM0-WhM1TM40ozJminEcULsWJ2yCxampyF8wcNAqBY261crawd3AjK2CoH9QGMBInLeaZ_zqp3TmHbd6zEuV_Mz8KqL5I3QndHccR_1MvF-n0N3FFroDd40WuivP9_qUjIWLfOVCTDvKLQyERZaFeJZjfq98Ct1Vm4-vg1KiYp0w8FgCpa-Uf5dq9_p_AAAA__8M5330) on July 2. Bexar County Public Health Director Andrea Guerrero is urging residents to [keep pets vaccinated](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAYhJ8Gb1iAAdsDQxdv6drR-mP-OKgYIvhrJ29fOVKfoMstJ913d1-X-QIhhrR-woaOnrc8JzxqRCIsM-VXJtjyHtJKsOQNKBM-oc5KKMtFz8UwewjxNevGu6vwo2zQyX7ojBisEM3d6V750fhuNAaNGeRNaqtRW0RjlV9kE9wZJnoxSCk6ObbS2ms_Cr0MUoAyyLRAHyiXlu74xt_iK-9Y2iVvTXR3okdl3QdTE1PTcRztdwU6Taamcw1TU8wLRKamE8XUJPo_qZA4JMopZA4FgT-QeD4Slsp_yoqeU-Y7LEtIQMghhQ1i5bAFzwtcA1ZeEWpOTE1Ncf5xhBhDtT3TYt0gxHdJ-t-1u1O_AQAA__99iY2M), report strays, and stay alert around wildlife.
